edition.notes: Short public verses: dhyana of Dakshina Kali + Argala Stotra opening (Devi Mahatmya tradition). Not Karpuradi, not a dumped sahasranama.

description.hi: संक्षिप्त महाकाली स्तुति — ध्यान व अर्गला का सार्वजनिक पद।
description.en: A short Mahakali hymn from public dhyana and Argala verses.
